messages:
marta: Heads-up — vendor sent a credit memo that AP posted without a PO match. Invoice INV-2026-113 split across two GLs and ended up routed to ENG-OPS approver instead of vendor relations. PDF uploaded to Concur and linked in the record. @devin @alex can you triage?

devin: on it. Can you confirm vendor name and total credit amount? I'll check the approver routing rules and Coupa match logs.

marta: Vendor: Zenith Labs. Total credit $10,000 (7k / 3k split). Vendor email says credit applies to an earlier PO number but the AP scan shows no PO. Link: https://concur.company/receipts/INV-2026-113

ProcureBot: Coupa match attempt: no active PO found for invoice INV-2026-113. Closest matches: PO#87654 (closed 2025-11-02), PO#88765 (open). Suggested PO 88765 (vendor-specified) — awaiting manual confirmation.

alex: I can confirm PO 87654 was closed. Zenith mentioned 88765 in their email but we never received a matching goods receipt for that PO. If 88765 is correct, we can rematch; otherwise we need to create a credit PO or route to vendor-credit GL.

sam: AP view: credit memo posted to AP Clearing with GL split as follows. Posting snippet pasted below — holding final post until rematch decision.

```csv
invoice,line,amount,gl_code,percent
INV-2026-113,1,7000,6110-EngOps,70%
INV-2026-113,2,3000,8005-CloudCosts,30%
```

sam: Approver on record was ENG-OPS group (wrong). If we rematch to PO 88765, approver should be @lisa (Vendor Relations) per routing rule for Zenith.

lisa: I just spoke with Zenith — they confirmed the credit should apply to PO#88765 and said they transposed a digit in the PDF header. They resent the credit memo with PO 88765 noted. I can vouch for the rematch. @ProcureBot can you attempt re-association? :eyes: 

ProcureBot: Re-association queued. Match to PO 88765 found and validated (vendor: Zenith Labs, supplier ID ZEN-001). Ticket created: FIN-892. Status: awaiting AP reapply.

devin: Perfect. Plan: 1) Procurement re-associates invoice to PO 88765 (ProcureBot/Ticket FIN-892). 2) AP (sam) holds posting until reapply is confirmed. 3) If reapply fails, AP will park to vendor suspense GL (2100) and we'll create a reversing journal once fixed. 4) I'll open a quick routing tweak to ensure vendor credits from Zenith route to @lisa automatically.

sam: Holding posting and adding note to invoice record: "Hold for PO rematch — FIN-892". If ProcureBot confirms, I'll reapply and finalize posting.

alex: Also proposing a small automation: detect when incoming credit memos reference closed PO numbers and flag for manual review. I'll draft an RFC.

marta: Thanks everyone. Owner for closure: ProcureBot (do rematch) + sam (final post). Please update FIN-892 with final status when done. Closing conditions: rematch succeeded and posting completed. :thumbsup:

lisa: I'll follow up with Zenith to confirm they see the rematch succeed on their side.

sam: noted. I'll ping when posted.

ProcureBot: FIN-892 updated: rematch completed at 1768010300, awaiting AP finalize.

sam: posted at 1768010449. moved credit from AP Clearing -> applied to PO 88765, GL split unchanged. Closing ticket.

marta: resolved, thanks team.
